set_review.differentiation_evidence: Actual saved pixels show six distinct explanatory signatures: planar structural-validation tiers with output comparison; indigo sectional partition shelves; orange planned data terraces with disconnected medical enclave; plum diagonal lifecycle rail and exposed checks; olive exploded Skill anatomy with test/evidence return; brick-red evidence fan-in and navy authority barrier. Layout, hierarchy, connectors and annotations visibly differ. Six palette families; no more than two generic input/output layouts. All six use white backgrounds and exact source-bound labels; full-size viewing is needed for fine labels on mobile.
